module origen_107657(
    input [1:0] sel,
    input [3:0] in,
    output reg out
);
    always @(*) begin
        case(sel)
            2'b00: out = in[0];
            2'b01: out = in[1];
            2'b10: out = in[2];
            2'b11: out = in[3];
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module arith_add(
    input [31:0] a, b,
    input sel,
    output [31:0] out,
    output Z, V, N
);
    wire [31:0] b_xor = b ^ {32{sel}};
    wire [32:0] sum = a + b_xor + sel;
    
    assign out = sum[31:0];
    assign Z = (out == 32'b0);
    assign V = (a[31] ^ b_xor[31] ^ sum[31] ^ sum[32]);
    assign N = out[31];
endmodule

module cmp(
    input [31:0] a, b,
    input [1:0] sel,
    output reg out
);
    wire [31:0] diff;
    wire Z, V, N;
    
    arith_add adder(.a(a), .b(b), .sel(1'b1), .out(diff), .Z(Z), .V(V), .N(N));
    
    always @(*) begin
        case(sel)
            2'b00: out = Z;          // Equal
            2'b01: out = N ^ V;      // Less than
            2'b10: out = (N ^ V) | Z; // Less than or equal
            default: out = 1'b0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module bitwise_bool(
    input [31:0] a, b,
    input [1:0] sel,
    output [31:0] out
);
    genvar i;
    generate
        for(i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin : bool_ops
            mux4_1 mux(
                .sel(sel),
                .in({a[i] ^ b[i], a[i] | b[i], a[i] & b[i], a[i] & ~b[i]}),
                .out(out[i])
            );
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module shift(
    input [31:0] a,
    input [4:0] shamt,
    input [1:0] sel,
    output reg [31:0] out
);
    always @(*) begin
        case(sel)
            2'b00: out = a << shamt;                     // Logical left shift
            2'b01: out = a >> shamt;                     // Logical right shift
            2'b10: out = $signed(a) >>> shamt;           // Arithmetic right shift
            default: out = a;
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module ALU(
    input [31:0] a, b,
    input [5:0] fn,
    output reg [31:0] out
);
    wire [31:0] arith_out, bool_out, shift_out;
    wire cmp_out;
    
    arith_add arith(.a(a), .b(b), .sel(fn[0]), .out(arith_out));
    cmp compare(.a(a), .b(b), .sel(fn[1:0]), .out(cmp_out));
    bitwise_bool bool(.a(a), .b(b), .sel(fn[1:0]), .out(bool_out));
    shift shifter(.a(a), .shamt(b[4:0]), .sel(fn[1:0]), .out(shift_out));
    
    always @(*) begin
        case(fn[5:4])
            2'b00: out = {31'b0, cmp_out};
            2'b01: out = arith_out;
            2'b10: out = bool_out;
            2'b11: out = shift_out;
        endcase
    end
endmodule
